en.welcome_body: Just 5 questions. 2 minutes. We match you with the precise combination of experts your health concern actually needs — no guesswork, no generic advice.
en.welcome_reassure: Not a diagnosis · Expert-matched pathway · 46 care routes
en.q0_text: How do you prefer to approach your health?
en.q0_a1_sub: Doctor, tests, blood reports, prescriptions — I want regular English medicine
en.q0_a2_sub: Holistic / root-cause — without English medicines, work with the body
en.q0_a3_main: Both are fine — guide me based on my symptoms
en.q0_a4_main: Not sure — something doesn't feel right
en.q0_a4_sub: Please help me figure it out
en.q5_text: Tell us about your health history
en.q5_a1_main: I know what the problem is
en.q5_a1_sub: Match me with the right experts
en.q5_a2_main: I've tried multiple doctors — nothing has worked
en.q5_a3_main: I genuinely don't know what's wrong
en.q1_subtext: If you have multiple problems — just pick the main one here. You can select all other issues in the very next step!
en.q1_a1_sub: Work stress, constant exhaustion, overwhelmed, anxiety, burnout
en.q1_a2_sub: Gas, Acidity, Bloating, IBS, Fatty Liver, Constipation, Diarrhea
en.q1_a3_sub: Back pain, knee pain, neck pain, joint pain, posture problems
en.q1_a4_sub: Irregular periods, PCOD/PCOS, Acne / Pimples, skin-hair changes
en.q1_a5_sub: No energy, no motivation, sleepy all day, weakness
en.q1_a6_sub: Sugar/Diabetes, Thyroid, BP, Asthma, Kidney/Urine issues, Heart condition
en.q2_text: How long have you had this problem?
en.q2_a3_sub: Has been going on for a while
en.q2_a4_sub: Gets better for a while then comes back
en.q3_subtext: Select all that apply — then continue
en.q3_conceive: Want to conceive / Have a baby
en.q4_text: How is your daily life right now?
en.q4_a1_sub: Mostly sitting — very little physical movement
en.q4_a2_main: Very busy life — High mental stress
en.q4_a3_sub: Can't sleep properly, or sleeping too much
en.q4_a4_sub: Sugar, BP, Thyroid or other long-term disease
en.matching_sub: Finding the right care team for you.
en.triage_title: Your profile needs a personal review
en.triage_body: Your responses cover several health areas. Our Coordinator will personally review your profile and confirm the right care path for you.
en.triage_note: Coordinator will respond within 2 hours on working days.
en.alt_banner: 🌿 Ayurvedic / Natural Track — All practitioners operate under CCIM statutory framework.
en.seniority_body: Given your history with previous treatments, we will personally review your case brief before confirming your team.
en.triage_notice: Your team's final confirmation will be done by your Coordinator.
en.plan_trial_note: Introductory consultation — not a coordinated pathway
en.cta_note: Your Coordinator will confirm your team within 2 hours.
en.disclaimer: This is a care pathway recommendation — not a medical diagnosis. JeevanKey operates as a health management and coordination service under India's Telemedicine Practice Guidelines 2020.
en.active_lead_sub: Your main daily contact — leads your recovery plan.
en.wa_consent: I accept the Terms of Service and consent to care coordination via WhatsApp.
en.cta_btn: Connect with Our Team on WhatsApp →
